## GTA V for iPhone, iPad and Mac — 27 Nov update: crash fixes, max skills

**Fixed**
- Cayo Perico: the crash in the Music Locker cutscene (the handshake). The same bug was in other screens and signs, which could crash the game at random when they loaded: Acid Lab, Auto Shop boards, orbital cannon, mansion screens, the arcade, a few cars (Comet S2 Cabrio, I-Wagen, Molotok) and more.
- A new GTA Online character no longer gets stuck on the loading screen after you name it (4 GB devices).
- A crash while loading or joining a session, as flags, curtains and other cloth appear.
- iPhone X, 8 and older: a crash when memory ran short. They now start with the 2 GB settings.
- A missing game file is named by the launcher before Play, instead of the game crashing at the start. If it shows one, copy the whole game folder again.
- LiveContainer: no more "game hung" while the app is in the background.

**Trainer**
- GTA Online › Skills › **Max all skills**: stamina, shooting, strength, stealth, flying, driving and lung capacity to 100%, saved with your character.

**Known**
- iPhone 17 Pro on iOS 26: one report of the game closing right after Play. If it happens: launcher › Renderer › DXMT.
- On iOS 26 and older, very long sessions (1–2 hours) can run out of memory space. The logs now record it: crash reports welcome.

**Files**
- `GTAV-unsigned.ipa` (iPhone/iPad), `GTAV-mac.zip` (Mac). Packs, ScriptHook packs, server and GTA VI modpack: unchanged, keep the earlier ones.

## GTA V for iPhone, iPad and Mac — 21 Nov update: GTA Online & Native Metal Rework

**GTA Online**
- The GTA ONLINE page now runs Rockstar's own GTA Online, on local stand-ins for its servers: character creator, tutorial, free roam, phone, shops, properties and jobs. Friends join with a code.
- Known: the creator hides the chosen hair; a cloud warning shows at each start (saving works).

**Older devices**
- iOS/iPadOS 15 and later. The iPhone 6s (2 GB) plays it.
- On 2 GB devices every preset is now the set tested on an iPhone 6s: 800×450, 24 FPS, lowest detail. Raise what you like in Settings.

**Faster and cooler**
- New Metal core with precompiled shaders.
- Sharpen upscaler, the new iPhone default: +11.6% FPS on a hot iPhone 13 Pro.
- Lower FPS When Hot: a steady 40 FPS instead of swinging.
- Much faster loading on 2-core devices.

**Launcher, trainer, touch**
- New settings: Renderer (Metal 3, Metal 4 BETA, DXMT), Upscaler, Lower FPS When Hot, Detailed Logging, Sprint.
- Trainer: rebuilt Bodyguards and a new Interaction page.
- Touch: Zoom, Sprint modes, Inventory wheel sections, radio logos, Enter for passenger seats.

**Mods**
- ELS 1.05 runs from its original files (AdvancedHookV built in); more Windows functions for .asi mods.
- IMPORT SCRIPT leaves out .cs source files, which stopped every .NET mod.

**Fixed:** session passwords, the apartment door freeze, a low-RAM loading hang, a 2 GB-mode crash.
**Known:** lights can flicker on Metal while driving.

**Files**
- `GTAV-unsigned.ipa` (iPhone/iPad),
- `GTAV-mac.zip` (Mac),

author: uctikaren
content:
## GTA V for iPhone, iPad and Mac — 14 Nov update 2: choose your renderer

One more update before the big renderer work: you can now pick the renderer yourself.

**New: Renderer**
- Launcher › Settings › Display › **Renderer**: **Metal (BETA)** or **DXMT**. It takes effect when the game starts.
- **Metal (BETA)** stays the default: the new renderer, with faster shaders and fewer first-time freezes. It's the only one for iOS/iPadOS 16-17 and older chips (iPhone 8/8 Plus/X, A10/A10X iPads).
- **DXMT** is the renderer of the updates up to 10 Nov, now with all the new features since. Try it if Metal (BETA) runs worse or looks wrong on your device, and tell us which one runs better.
- On the Mac too.

**Good to know**
- DXMT needs iOS/iPadOS 18 or later and an A12 chip or newer (iPhone XS/XR and later; experimental on the A12). Elsewhere it won't start: if the game closes at Play, switch back to Metal (BETA).
- The first minutes after a switch can stutter while that renderer prepares its shaders.

**Files**
- `GTAV-unsigned.ipa` (iPhone/iPad), `GTAV-mac.zip` (Mac). Server, ScriptHook packs, GTA VI modpack and interiors pack: unchanged.

Free forever. The only official download is github.com/vancevcs/VPORT. Altered copies won't start.

author: uctikaren
content:
GTA V for iPhone, iPad and Mac — 14 Nov update

The new renderer gets faster and smoother. Thanks to everyone who sent logs!

**Smoother**
- New effects no longer freeze the game while their shaders are built: most are now built in the background, and an object may appear a moment later instead.
- Fewer stutters when driving fast through the city.

**Faster**
- Shaders take about 10% less GPU time, and less is written to memory each frame.
- Less CPU work for every object drawn (about a quarter less on a hot iPhone 13 Pro): better FPS once the phone warms up.
- Less memory used while loading.

**New**
- Texture Quality **Low** in the launcher, for 2-3 GB devices (half of Normal's detail).
- The log says when Low Power Mode is on.

**Tips**
- Low Power Mode limits the screen to 60 Hz and slows the phone: a 40 FPS limit runs at 30. Turn it off for more.
- A 30 or 40 FPS limit keeps the phone cooler and smoother than no limit.

**Files**
- `GTAV-unsigned.ipa` (iPhone/iPad), `GTAV-mac.zip` (Mac). Server, ScriptHook packs, GTA VI modpack and interiors pack: unchanged.

Free forever. The only official download is github.com/vancevcs/VPORT. Altered copies won't start.

## GTA V for iPhone, iPad and Mac — 13 Nov Hotfix

Fixes for the first reports on the new renderer. Thanks to everyone who sent logs and crash reports!

**Fixes**
- iOS / iPadOS 16: the game no longer quits 10-30 s after Play. Particle Shadows stay off on iOS 16-18 for now.
- GTA Online characters with pink, green or blue skin (iPhone/iPad).
- The 30 FPS lock is smooth again: frames were shown unevenly, and only ~26 FPS on the newest iPhones.
- Voice chat: the game's sound no longer goes silent while someone talks.
- iOS 16-17: fewer stutters in the first minutes (shaders are prepared on loading screens).
- The game keeps its shader cache when iOS clears storage, so fewer first-launch stutters come back.

**New**
- Who's talking: a microphone and the player's name at the top right (yours in yellow).
- Talk on a controller: PlayStation touchpad, Xbox Share or the Home button. Hold it, or press on and off (launcher › Settings › GTA Online › Talk Mode).

## GTA V for iPhone, iPad and Mac — 13 Nov update

**New renderer**
- The game draws with Metal directly, no more DXMT. Shaders are prepared at launch to cut first-time stutters. Tested on an M1 Mac and an iPhone 13 Pro so far: if something looks wrong, send a screenshot.

**New devices (experimental, untested)**
- iPhone 8 Plus and iPhone X (A11), iPad 7th gen (A10), iPad Pro 10.5" and 12.9" from 2017 (A10X).
- iOS 16 and 17.
- They start at DirectX 10 with the low-memory profile. 2 GB devices (iPhone 8, iPad 6th gen) will most likely run out of memory. Have one? Tell us how it runs (send the Logs folder).

**GTA Online**
- Hosts choose which weapons are allowed (trainer › GTA Online › Weapons Allowed).
- Server owners: an optional join password and weapon rules for the server's own session (console: `password`, `weapons`). Players enter it in launcher › Settings › GTA Online › Server Password.
- Fixed: a private lobby's password carrying over into the public server session.

**Fixes**
- No more "CBullet::sBulletInstance Pool Full" crash (Menyoo Tenfold + Rapid Fire).
- Trainer: explosive and fire bullets and explosive punches work. "NPCs ignore you" covers everyone.

**Trainer**
- Bodyguards: characters from your mods;
- Super powers: Flight (jump, hold Sprint), a dive slam, Strength.
- Teleport › Your places. iPhone: menu size and see-through.

**Touch and controllers**
- Key buttons for mods (F1–F12…): Edit controls › Keys (ScriptHook pack imported).
- Flashlight button, left stick in golf, optional Follow / Hold / Attack and Waypoint buttons.
- Controllers: hold L3 to crouch, again to lie down.
- The launcher fits 4.7" iPhones.

**Files**
- `GTAV-unsigned.ipa` (iPhone/iPad), `GTAV-mac.zip` (Mac), `GTAV-Online-Server.zip` (servers).

Free forever.

**9 Nov update**

**Graphics (iPhone, iPad)**

• "Dummy Object Pool Full" no longer closes the game: a huge map mod just loses the extra objects

**GTA VI (beta)**

**Launcher**

**Faster**
